requirement: The Mining Frigate shall extract ore at a minimum rate of 20 m^3/min in High Sec and 50 m^3/min in Low Sec, Null Sec, and Wormhole operations.
The Mining Frigate shall have a cargo capacity of at least 5,000 m^3, expandable by modules.
The Mining Frigate shall withstand at least 200 DPS in High Sec and 400 DPS in Low Sec, Null Sec, and Wormhole operations.
The Mining Frigate shall support deployment of at least 5 drones for mining and combat operations.
The Mining Frigate shall detect incoming threats within a range of at least 20 AU.
The Mining Frigate shall have a warp speed of at least 5 AU/s and an align time of at most 3 seconds.
The Mining Frigate shall lock and mine up to 3 asteroid targets simultaneously.
The Mining Frigate shall dock and offload ore at stations or POS within 60 seconds.
The Fleet Commander shall coordinate mining fleets of up to 10 frigates.
The Rorqual shall support onboard ore compression by a factor of 10.
The mining corporation shall maintain average profitability of at least 500,000,000 ISK per operational cycle.
The mining corporation shall maintain a fleet utilization rate of at least 80%.
The mining corporation shall extract at least 1,000,000 m^3 of ore per operational cycle.
The mining corporation shall ensure average ore delivery time of no more than 1,800 seconds per batch.
The mining corporation shall maintain minimum ore storage capacity of 10,000,000 m^3.
The mining corporation shall operate a fleet of at least 10 mining frigates per operational cycle.
The mining corporation shall ensure that at least 30% of mining operations in Low Sec and Null Sec have security escort coverage.
The mining corporation shall ensure threat response time in Low Sec and Null Sec does not exceed 60 seconds.
The mining corporation shall maintain operational uptime of at least 85% per cycle.
The mining corporation shall ensure that at least 90% of planned mining deployments are executed successfully.
The mining corporation shall keep operational costs at most 2,000,000,000 ISK per month.
The mining corporation shall maintain market adaptability of at least 75%.
